look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: a failing endpoint console, an open breaker switch, a closed-open-half-open state chain, the switch closed again with probe wins, and the Gateway end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.

scenes.desc: A failing endpoint console: requests and retries time out, the queue grows.
scenes.name: Retries make it worse

scenes.desc: The breaker opens: app and endpoint cards with a gapped switch, traffic stopped.
scenes.name: Switch opens

scenes.desc: Three state chips: closed, open, half-open, with the 5-failure and 5-minute thresholds.
scenes.name: State diagram

scenes.desc: The switch closes again: bridged gap, three probe wins, CLOSED.
scenes.name: Switch closes

scenes.desc: End card with the Gateway mark: fail fast, recover carefully.
scenes.name: Gateway

title: Circuit breakers for LLM calls
